title: Speed, Concentration, Opacity: RBI's Three AI Risks for CFOs
subtitle: At GFF 2026, RBI Deputy Governor Rohit Jain warned that AI in finance amplifies three old risks. A composite mid-market CFO must decide which automated credit and collections actions stay human-gated before the October board.
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 23 September 2026. Publicly reported facts: RBI Deputy Governor Rohit Jain, speaking at GFF 2026 in Mumbai (reported 9 September 2026), identified speed, concentration and opacity as the three concerns that emerging technologies amplify in finance. Automated systems can act faster than humans can respond; dependence on a few technology providers creates concentration; advanced models remain hard to explain. Institutions must detect, contain and intervene before a small error becomes a system event. Composite firm: Godavari Digital Credit Ltd. Composite decision-maker: CFO Ananya Sen.
thumbnail: RBI NAMED THREE AI RISKS. WHICH ONE SITS ON YOUR P&L FIRST?
